extension.description: Search and download subtitles from various sites
Εύρεση και λήψη υποτίτλων από διαφόρους ιστοτόπους
extension.disclaimer: This service is only for Greek subtitles. It is not published nor endorsed by any of the sites supported.
Υπηρεσία μόνο ελληνικών υποτίτλων. Δεν έχει δημοσιευθεί, ούτε εγκριθεί από οποιοδήποτε υποστηριζόμενο ιστότοπο.
extension.news:
[B]4.0.0[/B] - Add Subs4Free/Subs4Series, GreekSubs.net, YIFI, TVsubtitles.net and Moviesubtitles.org providers - Remove Vipsubs.gr, Xsubs.tv and Podnapisi.net providers (dead sites) - Disable Subtitles.gr (unreachable) by default - Subs4Free (movies only) fixed via curl user-agent; its series side is bot-walled on all tested networks - Rewrite GreekSubs.net and YIFI searches for the current site layouts, IMDB search support - Pass IMDB id to providers that support it for more accurate matches - Fix sorting by rating/downloads, fix Xsubs result handling before its removal - Restructure code into providers and utils packages - Port to current framework modules (tulip 4, parsers, unicache, netclient, fuzzywuzzy) - Drop Python 2 compatibility, replace tulip.compat with standard library - Various other tweaks
[B]3.7.0[/B] - Increase maximum possible timeout for search requests - Add separate setting for subtitles.gr sub download timeout - Utilize fuzzywuzzy to find synced subtitles (minimum match ratio 50, default 75, max 100) - Replace futures module with tulip solution - Various other tweaks
[B]3.6.2[/B] - Bug fixes for subtitles save function on vipsubs
[B]3.6.1[/B] - Broaden search results for vipsubs.gr - Allow subtitle to be saved both locally and within the manual choice - Ask before overwriting existing subs
